description:
Functional specifications / files: lib/zaq/channels/jido_chat_bridge.ex, jido_chat_bridge/adapter_options.ex (verify actual owner path), delivery_result.ex and existing CommunicationBridge seams. Consume the shared executor and verified adapter prerequisites; bridge executes one requested upload/send/edit, never another planner or hidden delivery lifecycle. Preserve ordinary text, formatting, explicit attachment-edit capability, streamed-message selection, provider receipts and callback cardinality. Use real provider attachment/message IDs. Support multiple upload batches and partial upload facts; uploads alone never confirm publication. Unknown adapters remain unsupported.
Approved behavior: executor owns abort sequential publication, continue root promotion after uncertainty, bounded concurrency default four and per-operation 30s timeout. Failed operations are not retried. Continue preparation failure keeps usable files or sends original text; requirements-error fallback acquires/uploads nothing and uses selected shared settings. No replacement send after uncertain final send/edit. Completion callback occurs once with confirmed final provider ID; callback/status/reporting failures cannot repeat transport.
Tests before implementation: actual adapter-boundary create/edit/upload requests, exact bytes/name/MIME/thread, stable original indices, upload batches and partial references, missing post ID unconfirmed, streaming final attachment edit without duplicate answer, no implicit generic-edit attachment support, callback exactly once/exception isolation, legacy adapters/Telegram absent metadata, text parity, runtime timeout and root promotion integration.
Branches: supported/unsupported, send/edit, upload/prepare/provider rejection/timeout, partial confirmation and later callbacks.
Mocking: local HTTP external boundary with real verified SDK and internal runtime; injected config, no global selection. Reference test/zaq/channels/jido_chat_delivery_test.exs in old worktree is scenario evidence only.
Documentation: bridge/adapter option contracts and docs/services/channels.md.
Action reuse: extend JidoChatBridge, AdapterOptions, DeliveryResult and verified provider operations; no new Action or parallel send path. Plan and prepared content remain Channel-local; trusted connection/actor comes from existing role boundary. Verification includes executor integration and API journeys. No PR7 notification consumer changes.

Implementation rules: Read AGENTS.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md, docs/conventions.md and docs/code-quality.md plus the owning service guide before work. Reference ../zaq-feat-channel-files is behavioral evidence, not code to copy wholesale. Preserve Outgoing.attachments and separate metadata-only Plan; PR2 FileSettings/resolver remain authoritative. Keep existing test behavior unless its exact change is explicitly approved; add new tests for the new grouped evidence contract. No PR6 Agent selection/AttachDocuments or PR7 workflow/notification implementation. Unit/integration/property/LiveView tests are immediate; new feature E2E belongs to the gated finalization task. Validation follows docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md; no per-step numerical coverage gate.

comments.text: Moved to PR5 per Jad seven-PR split. Not part of feat/delivery_plan PR4. Existing functional/test/reuse specification retained. Executor prerequisite and PR5 review/coverage finalization must be planned before implementation.
